rules.source: CBUAE Retail Payment Services and Card Schemes Regulation (Circular No. 15/2021)
rules.note: 从 UAE 在岸提供零售支付服务（含跨境汇款、支付账户发行）须持 CBUAE 相应类别牌照；本规则只检查在岸牌照证据。DIFC/ADGM 自贸区与 Dubai VARA 属不同监管轨，见 ae-vasp-license-path

rules.source: Federal Decree by Law No. (10) of 2025 (AML/CFT/CPF)
rules.note: 2025-10-14 起生效的新 AML 主法，取代 Federal Decree-Law No. (20) of 2018——引用旧法即过期。PASS 仅表示已提交书面 AML/CFT 计划证据，不表示该计划充分
受监管金融机构须在 UAE FIU 的 goAML 平台注册以履行可疑交易报告义务；本规则只检查注册证据是否存在；原注册指南 PDF（v3.4）已从官网下线，改引 goAML 官方门户入口（uaefiu.gov.ae 首页链接）

rules.source: Cabinet Resolution No. (134) of 2025 (Executive Regulations of the AML Law)
rules.note: 跨境转账须随附汇款人与收款人信息（FATF R.16 的本地化）；本规则只检查信息字段证据是否具备，不判断其真实性

rules.source: VARA VA Transfer and Settlement Services Rulebook
rules.note: UAE 对虚拟资产转移存在多轨监管（Dubai VARA / ADGM FSRA / DIFC DFSA / CBUAE），主体落在哪一轨无法由静态输入判定；缺证据时上报人工核实牌照路径而非扣住

rules.source: CBUAE Payment Token Services Regulation, Article (12): Restrictions on Payment Tokens
rules.note: USDC is a Foreign Payment Token; using it for payment within the UAE is restricted under the PTSR (in principle limited to scenarios such as virtual-asset purchases). Whether a pure outbound settlement falls within the restriction is a genuine grey area, so every case is escalated for human judgment — an honest treatment of the 'pay-in AED, settle in USDC' scenario, not a rule defect
